baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence from repeated ظن through تجسس and يغتب to eating a dead brother's flesh.
baseline_models.mechanism: Uncertain supposition is converted into a target by covert news-gathering; mention of the absent then turns concealed personal material into consumable speech and discord. The corpse image is the endpoint of an epistemic escalation, not an ornamental comparison.

activation_trace.role: Uncertain supposition supplies the unstable premise that the later acts try to harden.
Covert tracking of news turns an inward suspicion into an information-gathering act.
Hiddenness supplies the protected material that the probe seeks to expose.
Mention in absence converts the discovered material into injurious circulation.
The branch's discord-stirring and tale-bearing image makes social consumption part of eating itself.
Flesh gives the exposed person a vulnerable bodily substance that speech can consume.
Carrion makes the absent brother defenseless and unavailable to consent or reply.

changed_reading.before: Suspicion, spying, and backbiting are three adjacent prohibitions followed by a vivid simile.
changed_reading.after: They form a causal conversion chain: weak inference becomes covert extraction, then absent-person speech, then predatory social consumption.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: اجتنبوا كثيرا من الظن followed by إن بعض الظن إثم.
baseline_models.mechanism: The shift from 'many' to 'some', together with opposed branches of ظن, sorts judgments rather than erasing judgment. The danger is an abundance of low-indication suppositions among which some impede good; certainty responsibly grounded in indication remains a live coexisting category.

activation_trace.role: Abundance makes the command a discipline of proliferating judgments rather than one isolated thought.
Certainty after an indication preserves a possible responsible mode of judgment.
Weak supposition marks the epistemically unstable mode that needs restraint.
Partitioning prevents the warning about sinful suspicion from flattening every ظن into one class.
Sin as lagging from good renders bad suspicion obstructive, not merely incorrect.

changed_reading.before: The verse bans suspicion as a single undifferentiated mental state.
changed_reading.after: It demands epistemic triage: resist proliferating weak suppositions because some become morally obstructive, while not denying every indicated judgment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The movement from آمنوا and اجتنبوا through تجسسوا and يغتب to اتقوا.
baseline_models.mechanism: A community of trust requires an informational membrane. Keeping aside preserves distance; palpating with senses breaches what is hidden; protective caution restores the barrier. The object protected is not secrecy in the abstract but the other person's unoffered interior.

activation_trace.role: Settled security and trust name the social condition that invasive inquiry destroys.
Keeping aside supplies deliberate distance from the protected interior.
Knowing by gentle touch makes even a subtle probe a boundary-crossing diagnostic act.
Sense organs supply the apparatus by which curiosity reaches across the boundary.
Being hidden from sight or knowledge defines the interior that is not automatically available.
A protective barrier turns taqwa into the closing structural answer to intrusion.

changed_reading.before: The verse tells individuals to suppress curiosity and gossip.
changed_reading.after: It establishes a social membrane: trust depends on preserving another person's right not to be palpated, sensed, or exposed.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The three occurrences of بعض around أخيه, لحمه, and ميتا.
baseline_models.mechanism: Repeated portioning cuts a communal whole into speaker, target, and consumed fragment. Yet flesh also joins and kinship tethers; stripping flesh from bone therefore figures backbiting as dismembering the very relation that holds the speakers together.

activation_trace.role: Partition into portions gives the repeated بعض a dismembering pressure across thought and speech.
Joining and adhering makes flesh connective tissue as well as edible matter.
The kinship branch joins bodily flesh directly to the brother relation.
Stripping flesh from bone supplies the destructive action performed on the shared body.
The tethering bond makes brotherhood a relation whose severing harms both ends.
Loss of vitality makes the targeted member unable to participate in or repair the speech event.

changed_reading.before: Backbiting harms another member of the group.
changed_reading.after: Backbiting portions and strips a body held together by kinship; the speaker consumes connective tissue belonging to the same communal body.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أيحب أحدكم أن يأكل ... فكرهتموه followed by واتقوا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The question catches love as clinging appetite, fuses tale-bearing with eating, and turns that appetite into aversion. Protective caution then stabilizes the reversal. The verse acts on desire, not only on rule-compliance.

activation_trace.role: Clinging attachment supplies the appetite whose object the question exposes.
The heart's inner kernel locates the appetite at the center of valuation rather than at the mouth alone.
Literal ingestion gives the social act its bodily appetite and incorporation.
Discord-stirring and tale-bearing keep the eating image attached to the prohibited speech.
Aversion opposite satisfaction performs the desired reversal of appetite.
Self-protective caution holds the newly repelled appetite in practice.

changed_reading.before: The corpse simile shocks the listener into obeying a prohibition.
changed_reading.after: The simile is an affective operation: it reveals attachment to injurious speech, recodes it as carrion appetite, and trains love into aversion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The close إن الله تواب رحيم after the flesh-eating image.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ending does not leave the offender fixed as predator. Sin delays good, but flesh can also close a wound, repentance remains callable, and mercy includes kinship. The close opens a return from consumed relation toward repaired attachment.

activation_trace.role: Lagging from good makes the offense a reversible obstruction rather than a final identity.
A wound reaching or closing with flesh activates bodily repair after the stripping image.
The invitation-to-repent image keeps the offender addressable after the horror.
Tender mercy supplies the affective condition for repair.
Kinship makes mercy restore the same relational field that brother-flesh marked as damaged.

changed_reading.before: The final divine names are a general assurance after severe warning.
changed_reading.after: They complete the body's logic: consumed kinship can still be recalled, the wound can close, and the offender can return without being reduced to the offense.

context_deltas.mechanism: The early context supplies a choreography of access: do not advance, do not demand from behind an enclosure, and wait for voluntary emergence. This spatial etiquette strengthens the focus ayah's informational membrane: another person's concealed interior is approached by permission and disclosure, not breached by diagnostic touch.

activation_trace.role: Keeping aside anchors the focus command in deliberate non-encroachment.
Diagnostic touch names the subtle breach that the spatial sequence illuminates.
Advancing ahead supplies the prohibited movement of crossing an order of access.
Covering something behind backs supplies concealment that remains in place until offered.
Prevention and enclosure give the chambers a real boundary function in the analogy.
Holding oneself back supplies the alternative to forced access: waiting.

structural_cues: 49:1 forbids advancing ahead; 49:4-5 contrasts calling from behind chambers with waiting for an invited exit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies advance, enclosure, concealment, and waiting; I map that physical access sequence onto access to a person's hidden condition. The live alternative is that these are only protocols of prophetic etiquette, but the focus roots still sustain the boundary analogy.

changed_reading.before: Do not spy means do not gather private facts.
changed_reading.after: Do not spy also means do not force an interior to emerge; ethical access waits at the boundary for disclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: 49:6 routes an incoming report through accountable clarification before a people become its target. Against that route, تجسس appears as counterfeit verification: suspicion bypasses open clarification, searches covertly, and still produces a struck social target and belated regret.

activation_trace.role: Weak supposition is the unverified starting state shared by the harmful route.
Covert tracking names the illicit substitute for accountable clarification.
A delivered report supplies the external claim that must not move directly into action.
Clarifying meaning by speech or sign supplies the public evidentiary checkpoint.
Aiming and hitting a target exposes the social consequence of failed verification.
Absence of knowledge marks action taken before the evidentiary gap is repaired.
Regret after a missed opportunity supplies the irreversible lag behind injury.

structural_cues: 49:6 orders report, clarification, possible impact on a people, ignorance, and remorse as a consequence sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the 49:6 sequence; I treat covert probing in 49:12 as a rival route for resolving uncertainty and infer that it lacks the accountable checkpoint. The alternative is that 49:6 concerns public reports while 49:12 concerns privacy, but that difference sharpens rather than removes the contrast.

changed_reading.before: Spying may look like overzealous fact-checking before speaking.
changed_reading.after: The context separates verification from spying: responsible inquiry clarifies an offered report before impact, while covert inquiry manufactures a target from suspicion.

context_deltas.mechanism: 49:7 describes faith made beloved, beautified in hearts, and wrongdoing made hated. The focus ayah reuses love and hate around eating, so its corpse scene can function as the local performance of that formation: an injurious appetite is shown its object and its valuation is turned.

activation_trace.role: Clinging love supplies the focus question's exposed appetite.
Tale-bearing as eating identifies the appetite being morally revalued.
Aversion opposite satisfaction is the focus scene's achieved affective reversal.
Love clinging to the heart supplies the positive side of formed desire.
Making something appear beautiful explains how an object becomes affectively attractive.
Turning a thing from its face activates the heart as a site where valuation can reverse.
Made aversion supplies the context's negative side of moral formation.

structural_cues: 49:7 coordinates made-beloved, beautified in hearts, and made-hated before 49:12 asks about loving an act and declares aversion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated love/hate roots and heart-centered valuation; I infer that the focus simile performs the retraining described earlier. The live alternative is that disgust only intensifies prohibition, but the repeated affective architecture supports a formative reading.

changed_reading.before: The listener already hates the imagined act, and the verse merely exploits that reaction.
changed_reading.after: The verse actively reforms desire: it transfers the moral ugliness of backbiting into felt bodily aversion and makes disgust a trained ethical capacity.

context_deltas.mechanism: 49:9-10 repeatedly repairs what stands between believers, balances the relation, and names them brothers. The focus image then becomes the inverse operation: absent speech consumes connective flesh instead of restoring the tether. Abstention is therefore incomplete without relational repair.

activation_trace.role: Joining and adhering make brother-flesh the connective material that gossip damages.
The tethering bond gives the harmed relation two connected ends.
Removing estrangement supplies the active repair opposed to absent-person speech.
A connection standing between parties gives repair a relational site rather than two isolated selves.
A straight balance supplies the non-predatory way to handle conflict and competing claims.
The repeated brother tether makes reconciliation the expected motion within the collective body.

structural_cues: 49:9 repeats reconciliation around return and justice; 49:10 compresses believers into brotherhood and again commands repair between them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated repair, between-ness, balance, and brotherhood; I infer that the flesh image depicts the connective relation those acts should restore. The alternative is a narrower ban on speech, but the nearby repair sequence gives abstention a positive sequel.

changed_reading.before: The remedy for backbiting is to stop speaking about the absent person.
changed_reading.after: Stopping predation is only the first move; the larger mechanism restores what stands between tethered siblings and closes damaged connective tissue.

context_deltas.mechanism: 49:11 moves from ridicule and faulting 'yourselves' to reciprocal labeling. A name can become a public sign that fixes one fault as the person's identity. The focus ayah's repeated portions and absent mention then expose backbiting as a reflexive classificatory wound: a fragment is detached, named, and circulated against the common self.

activation_trace.role: Portioning supplies the fragment of a person that speech detaches and treats as the whole.
Mention in absence is the channel through which the detached fragment circulates.
Ridicule supplies the social pleasure that turns another into an object.
Faulting supplies the selected defect that speech detaches from a fuller person.
The thing itself or self makes injury to another member reflexively an injury to yourselves.
A name as public designation and sign supplies the mechanism that stabilizes a fault into identity.

structural_cues: 49:11 makes the object of faulting 'yourselves' and proceeds from mockery through reciprocal naming.
ن ب ز at 49:11[27] and ل ق ب at 49:11[28] are branchless packet cues used only for the reciprocal naming structure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ridicule, fault, self-reference, and naming; I infer the arrow from selecting a fault to fixing and circulating it as identity. The alternative is that 49:11 and 49:12 list separate speech harms, but the self-reference and partitive repetition support a shared wound mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Backbiting reports a real or alleged fault while the person is absent.
changed_reading.after: Backbiting is identity manufacture: it cuts out one fault, fixes it as a public sign, and wounds the speaker's own collective self.

context_deltas.mechanism: 49:13 does not answer hiddenness with ignorance; branching peoples can gather, face one another, and recognize by offered signs. That supplies the ethical counterpart to تجسس: reciprocal recognition honors presented identity, whereas covert probing extracts what has not been presented.

activation_trace.role: Covert news-tracking supplies the unilateral knowledge practice being contrasted.
Hiddenness marks material that reciprocal encounter has not offered.
Branching and dispersal preserve real difference rather than dissolving it.
Gathering and mending a split show that differentiated branches can enter relation without covert fusion.
Groups facing one another supply reciprocity and visible encounter.
Recognition by trace or sign supplies knowledge responsive to what appears rather than invasive excavation.

structural_cues: 49:13 places created differentiation before the reciprocal form لتعارفوا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies differentiated groups, face-to-face collectivity, and recognition by signs; I infer reciprocity as the ethical axis distinguishing recognition from spying. The alternative is that 49:13 concerns intergroup identity rather than privacy, but both readings can coexist because the focus remains anchored in how knowledge is acquired.

changed_reading.before: The prohibition of spying favors knowing less about other people.
changed_reading.after: It favors a different way of knowing: mutual, face-to-face recognition through offered signs instead of unilateral extraction from hiddenness.

context_deltas.mechanism: 49:14 distinguishes a spoken identity claim from faith entering the heart; 49:15 names unsettled doubt; 49:16 contrasts telling God one's religion with God's disclosure-free knowledge. The focus sequence can therefore be read as a warning against acting as if suspicion grants entry into another's inward reality.

activation_trace.role: Uncertain supposition supplies the unstable judgment about another's interior.
Diagnostic touch supplies the attempted entry from supposition into claimed knowledge.
The inward and secret interior marks the heart's reality as distinct from public profession.
Agitated doubt supplies an interior state that cannot safely become another person's verdict.
Disclosure of a thing to the knower marks the complete knowledge explicitly assigned to God.
Entrusting or attesting religion supplies the claimed identity humans presume to present as settled knowledge.

structural_cues: 49:14 separates saying 'we believe' from faith entering hearts; 49:16 contrasts announcing religion to God with God's knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies claim/interior disparity and divine knowledge; I infer that human suspicion plus probing counterfeits entry into that interior. The live alternative is that these verses police one's own sincerity, yet that uncertainty itself limits confident classification of others.

changed_reading.before: Suspicion is dangerous mainly because it may be factually false.
changed_reading.after: Suspicion becomes dangerous when it is treated as unauthorized interior access and hardened into a verdict about who another person really is.

context_deltas.mechanism: 49:17 portrays reminded favor as weight placed on its recipient and as a cut in relational continuity. This activates a non-food branch of eating in the focus ayah: backbiting can consume social credit, turning intimacy or past generosity into leverage over a tethered brother.

activation_trace.role: Consuming or taking another's wealth extends eating from food to extractive appropriation.
The tethered bond supplies the relation from which social credit is extracted.
Firm interlacing supplies the continuity that leverage and exposure pull apart.
Reminding a recipient of a favor supplies speech that burdens another with one's gift.
Cutting and diminishing until continuity ends supplies the relational result of such leverage.

structural_cues: 49:17 repeats the favor claim, reverses its subject, and denies the speaker ownership of the other person's guidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies burdening reminder and severed continuity; I transfer that extraction pattern to the focus eating/kinship complex. The alternative is that 49:17 only corrects boasting before the Messenger, so the social-credit reading remains exploratory rather than a lexical gloss of backbiting.

changed_reading.before: Eating flesh represents only the consumption of reputation through hostile speech.
changed_reading.after: It can also expose a creditor-like appetite: converting shared history, gifts, or intimacy into consumable leverage over a brother.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final context assigns knowledge of the unseen and comprehensive sight of deeds to God. Human تجسس, by contrast, mobilizes the senses to eliminate uncertainty about another. The prohibition thus becomes epistemic restraint: human community can act responsibly without claiming total surveillance.

activation_trace.role: The organs of sensing supply the finite human apparatus recruited by surveillance.
Hiddenness marks the limit that human probing tries to erase.
Complete disclosure to the knower supplies the knowledge explicitly predicated of God.
The unseen hidden from eyes names the domain whose knowledge is divinely held.
Visual seeing supplies direct observation without the human covert-probe mechanism.
Insight of the heart extends divine seeing beyond exposed surfaces.

structural_cues: 49:18 closes the context by pairing God's knowledge of the unseen with God's sight of what people do.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine unseen-knowledge and sight after the human spying prohibition; I infer an asymmetry that asks humans to relinquish total epistemic control. The alternative is a general warning of accountability, which can coexist with the anti-surveillance reading.

changed_reading.before: Do not spy because private information is socially dangerous.
changed_reading.after: Do not spy because finite agents need not and must not imitate total sight; responsible relation includes yielding some hiddenness to divine knowledge.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant split mapping from focus ء ك ل to ك ل ل; it remains anchored in repeated بعض and يأكل, but downstream prose should present it only as a form-distant resonance, never as the lexical meaning of يأكل.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Repeated بعض around يأكل and the split ء ك ل inventory's totality branch.

activation_trace.role: Partition supplies the partial suspicion or fault selected from a larger person.
The split branch's totality and completeness image supplies the jump from one fragment to a total verdict.
Absent mention circulates the totalized verdict where the fuller person cannot interrupt it.

changed_reading.before: Backbiting consumes a piece of the absent person's reputation.
changed_reading.after: It first totalizes: one partial suspicion becomes the whole person, and that manufactured whole is then consumed in speech.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This hunting-and-wound model is materially strange but all of its branches occur in the focus ayah and converge on the dead-flesh scene; it should be rendered as an image-level mechanism, not as a claim that the verse literally describes hunting.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: تجسسوا, يأكل, لحم, and ميتا within the single predatory simile.

activation_trace.role: Palpation to know a condition supplies the search for a vulnerable point.
Eaten prey or an animal set aside for eating turns the target into quarry.
A wound reaching flesh supplies the discovered weakness that can be exploited.
Checking whether wounded game is dead supplies the final test that the target cannot resist.

changed_reading.before: The absent brother is passive because death intensifies the horror of eating flesh.
changed_reading.after: The sequence resembles predation: probe for a wound, establish defenselessness, and convert the brother from interlocutor into consumable quarry.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The ecological image is branch-distant, yet it is anchored by focus غيب's hidden-tree-roots branch, diagnostic probing, and flesh as kinship; downstream prose should mark it as a material analogy for concealed support, not a lexical paraphrase of backbiting.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: تجسسوا and يغتب beside the brother/kinship flesh complex.

activation_trace.role: Touch used to discover condition supplies the excavating probe.
Hidden tree roots supply concealed structures that nourish what is visible.
Kinship makes the buried support relational rather than merely botanical.
The tethering bond supplies the living connection damaged by excavation and exposure.

changed_reading.before: Spying uncovers a hidden fact about an individual.
changed_reading.after: Spying digs into hidden relational roots; exposing them can injure the unseen supports by which the shared body remains connected.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation is especially form-distant because it uses the packet's non-dominant ه د ي to ه د د split branch; it remains anchored by focus ظن and the closing turn toward repentance, but prose must label it a cross-root resonance rather than a meaning of هدى.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The repeated ظن and the closing تواب within 49:12, activated by 49:17's هدى cue.

activation_trace.role: Weak supposition supplies the self-generated projection from which the focus command withdraws.
The split branch's image of casting imagined suspicion into the self supplies a startling negative foil to guidance.
Calling to repentance supplies a possible return from projection-driven judgment.

changed_reading.before: The close offers pardon after failures of suspicion and speech.
changed_reading.after: The close can also mark reorientation: relinquishing projections generated within the self so that guidance, rather than imagined suspicion, directs relation.

strongest_changes: The prohibitions became a causal chain from weak inference through covert extraction to predatory circulation.
49:6 separated accountable verification from spying as a counterfeit route to certainty.
49:7 turned the corpse scene into active retraining of love, appetite, and aversion.
49:9-13 supplied positive alternatives: repair of connective brotherhood and reciprocal recognition through offered signs.
49:18 reframed non-spying as acceptance of the asymmetry between finite human sensing and divine knowledge of the unseen.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah sustained several coexisting mechanisms without collapse: epistemic escalation, a consent-like social boundary, dismemberment of a collective body, affective reformation, and reparable kinship. Split mappings also exposed contained but live resonances in which a partial fault becomes a total person and guidance displaces projected suspicion.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal arrows from suspicion to probing to backbiting are reconstructed from sequence and branch fit, not explicitly marked as necessary steps by grammar.
The verification/spying and recognition/spying contrasts may be contextual juxtapositions rather than direct formal oppositions.
The communal-body and wound-closing models depend on material branches of ل ح م that may remain imagistic rather than interpretively governing.
The ء ك ل to ك ل ل and ه د ي to ه د د activations are deliberately retained split-root outliers and must not be lexicalized.
The branchless ن ب ز and ل ق ب cues support only the structure of reciprocal labeling; no branch identity is inferred for them.
